name: American Decades
description: A musical road trip through the United States, one original piece for every decade since 1776: fife and drum, minuets and reels, shape-note hymns, spirituals and parlor songs, Civil War bugles and cowboy trails, Sousa-style marches, ragtime, barbershop, Dixieland and the Charleston, swing and boogie-woogie, doo-wop, Motown and disco, electro and boom bap, pop-punk, EDM and hyperpop. Every tune is newly written in the style of its era, and each one is a complete piece, typically a minute and a half or more, with its own sections, repeats, variations and a real ending.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: 1770s · Liberty Fife
sketches.description: The Revolution marches by: a fife and drum corps rolls off, plays a march in G and a trio in C, a second fife joins on the repeats, and the corps halts. The boots come close and pass by.

sketches.name: 1780s · Philadelphia Minuet
sketches.description: Candlelit drawing rooms of the new republic: a minuet in D and its answer, each played twice, a trio in G with a solo violin, then the minuet da capo with ornaments, for harpsichord and string quartet with a clock ticking on the mantel.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/3)

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4. Minuet and trio: each strain repeated, then the minuet da capo with ornaments
song("(minuet@8)*2 (answer@8)*2 trio@16 minuet'@8 answer'@8", "once")
tempomap("0:32 60:32 64:22")

// The right hand: the minuet in D and its answer through A, ornamented on the da capo
harpsichord: stack(
  note("<[d5 f#5 a5] [g5@2 e5] [f#5 d5 b4] [a4@3] [b4 d5 g5] [f#5 e5 d5] [e5 a4 c#5] [d5@3]>").sections("minuet"),
  note("<[a5 g5 f#5] [e5@2 c#5] [d5 f#5 a5] [g5@2 e5] [f#5 d5 a4] [b4 g5 e5] [d5 c#5 e5] [d5@3]>").sections("answer")
).variant(x => x.ply("<1 2 1 1 2 1 2 1>"))
  .s("square").pw(.15).attack(.002).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.15)
  .lpf(3500).room(.35).gain(.18)

// The left hand: a broken bass on each beat, through the minuet, the answer and the trio in G
left: stack(
  note("<[d3 a3 f#3] [g2 b3 g3] [d3 b3 g3] [a2 c#3 e3] [g2 d3 b3] [d3 a3 f#3] [a2 e3 g3] [d3 a3 d4]>").sections("minuet"),
  note("<[a2 e3 c#4] [a2 c#3 e3] [d3 a3 f#3] [e2 b2 g3] [d3 a3 f#3] [g2 d3 b3] [a2 e3 g3] [d3 a3 d4]>").sections("answer"),
  note("<[g2 d3 b3] [d3 a3 c4] [g2 d3 b3] [g2 b2 d3] [c3 g3 e4] [g2 d3 b3] [d3 a3 c4] [g2 d3 g3]>").sections("trio")
).s("square").pw(.2).attack(.002).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.1)
  .lpf(2200).room(.35).gain(.14)

// A string quartet holding the harmony
strings: stack(
  note("<[d4,f#4] [b3,e4] [b3,d4] [c#4,e4] [b3,d4] [a3,d4] [c#4,g4] [d4,f#4]>").sections("minuet"),
  note("<[c#4,e4] [c#4,a4] [d4,f#4] [e4,g4] [d4,f#4] [b3,d4] [c#4,g4] [d4,f#4]>").sections("answer"),
  note("<[g3,b3] [f#3,a3] [g3,b3] [g3,d4] [g3,c4] [g3,b3] [f#3,c4] [g3,b3]>").sections("trio")
).s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.08).lpf(1800)
  .attack(.15).sustain(.6).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.12)

// In the trio a solo violin takes the tune
violin: note("<[b4@2 d5] [c5@2 a4] [b4 g4 b4] [d5@3] [e5@2 c5] [b4@2 g4] [a4 f#4 a4] [g4@3]>").sections("trio")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5.5).vibdepth(.12).lpf(2600)
  .attack(.08).sustain(.7).release(.3).room(.5).gain(.16)

// A clock on the mantel
clock: s("tick ~ ~").gain(.05)

sketches.name: 1790s · Federal Reel
sketches.description: A country dance in a tavern hall: a fiddle reel in A and its turn, twice through and once more up the octave, over a drone, a vamping keyboard and dancers' feet on the wooden floor.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)

// A contra dance: a pickup, the reel and its turn twice through, once more up the octave, and a final chord
song("call@2 (reel@8 turn@8)*2 reel'@8 turn'@8 out@2", "once")
tempomap("0:29 50:29 52:22")

// The fiddle calls, the dancers answer with their feet
fiddle: stack(
  note("<~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ e4 g#4]>").sections("call"),
  note("<[a4 c#5 e5 c#5 a4 c#5 e5 a5] [f#5 e5 d5 c#5 b4 a4 b4 c#5] [d5 f#5 a5 f#5 e5 c#5 a4 c#5] [b4 g#4 e4 g#4 a4@2 ~ e4]>").sections("reel"),
  note("<[e5 f#5 e5 c#5 a4 c#5 e5 f#5] [a5 f#5 e5 c#5 d5 c#5 b4 a4] [b4 c#5 d5 b4 a4 b4 c#5 e5] [a4@2 c#5 b4 a4@2 ~ e4]>").sections("turn"),
  note("<[a4,e5] ~>").sections("out")
).variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(3000)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.1).attack(.02).decay(.15).sustain(.5).release(.08)
  .room(.3).gain(.28)

// A second fiddle drones the open strings
drone: note("[a3,e4]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(1400)
  .attack(.1).sustain(1).release(.3).gain(.1)

// A keyboard vamping: A, D, A, E for the reel, A, D, E, A for the turn
vamp: stack(
  note("<a2 d2 a2 e2>").sections("reel"),
  note("<a2 d2 e2 a2>").sections("turn")
).struct("x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.2).sustain(0).gain(.3)
chords: stack(
  note("<[c#4,e4,a4] [d4,f#4,a4] [c#4,e4,a4] [b3,e4,g#4]>").sections("reel"),
  note("<[c#4,e4,a4] [d4,f#4,a4] [b3,e4,g#4] [c#4,e4,a4]>").sections("turn")
).struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.2)

// The last chord
final: note("<[a2,e3,a3,c#4,e4] ~>").sections("out")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.8).sustain(0).gain(.3)

// Feet on the wooden floor
feet: s("step ~ step ~ step ~ step step").lpf(1500).gain(.25).exceptSections("out")

sketches.name: 1800s · Fuguing Tune
sketches.description: Shape-note singing from the new tunebooks: three parts in a hollow square sing a plain chordal verse, then a fuguing section where bass, tenor and treble enter one by one, all twice over, and close on an amen in open fifths.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// A fuguing tune: a plain verse, then the parts enter one after another, all sung twice, and an amen
song("(plain@8 fugue@8)*2 amen@2", "once")
tempomap("0:21 32:21 34:14")

// Parts facing each other in a hollow square, open fifths and all
treble: stack(
  note("<[a4 c5 b4 a4] [g4@2 e4@2] [a4 b4 c5 d5] [e5@4] [d5 c5 b4 a4] [g4 a4 b4 g4] [a4 e4 g4 e4] [a4@4]>").sections("plain"),
  note("<~ ~ ~ ~ [a4 c5 e5 a5] [g5 e5 d5 e5] [c5 b4 a4 g4] [a4@4]>").sections("fugue"),
  note("<f4 a4>").sections("amen")
).s("choir").syl("ah").attack(.1).release(.4).pan(.3).room(.4).gain(.22)
tenor: stack(
  note("<[e4 e4 d4 e4] [d4@2 b3@2] [e4 g4 a4 b4] [a4@4] [g4 a4 g4 e4] [d4 e4 d4 b3] [c4 b3 d4 b3] [e4@4]>").sections("plain"),
  note("<~ ~ [e3 g3 b3 e4] [d4 b3 a3 b3] [c4 a3 g3 e3] [a3 g3 a3 b3] [c4 b3 a3 g3] [a3@4]>").sections("fugue"),
  note("<a3 e4>").sections("amen")
).s("choir").syl("oh").attack(.1).release(.4).pan(.6).room(.4).gain(.24)
bass: stack(
  note("<[a2 a2 g2 a2] [g2@2 e2@2] [a2 e2 a2 g2] [a2@4] [g2 a2 e2 c3] [g2 e2 g2 e2] [a2 e2 e2 e2] [a2@4]>").sections("plain"),
  note("<[a2 c3 e3 a3] [g3 e3 d3 e3] [a2@2 c3 e3] [d3 c3 b2 g2] [a2 e2 a2 c3] [d3 e3 d3 b2] [c3 b2 g2 e2] [a2@4]>").sections("fugue"),
  note("<d3 a2>").sections("amen")
).s("choir").syl("oo").attack(.1).release(.4).room(.4).gain(.26)

// The leader's hand beating time on the bench
beat: s("rim ~ rim ~").lpf(1200).gain(.12).exceptSections("amen")

sketches.name: 1810s · Ramparts at Dawn
sketches.description: The War of 1812: drums are heard from afar, a military band on the fort walls plays its anthem in Bb, weathers a bombardment of ominous minor stabs and cannon fire, plays the anthem once more in full and greets the dawn.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)

// Drums from afar, the anthem twice, the bombardment, the anthem in full, and dawn
song("distant@4 (anthem@8)*2 siege@8 anthem'@8 dawn@4", "once")
tempomap("0:26 36:26 40:18")

// Massed brass in Bb, ominous under fire, fuller on the last anthem
brass: stack(
  note("<[[bb3,d4,f4]@3 [bb3,d4,f4]] [c4,eb4,f4,a4] [[bb3,d4,f4,bb4] [eb4,g4,bb4]] [[d4,f4,bb4] [c4,f4,a4]]>").sections("anthem"),
  note("<[g3,bb3,d4] [eb3,g3,bb3] [c3,eb3,g3] [d3,f#3,a3]>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~").sections("siege"),
  note("<[bb3,d4,f4] [eb4,g4,bb4] [c4,eb4,f4,a4] [bb3,d4,f4,bb4]>").sections("dawn")
).s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(1400).lpenv(1.5).lpattack(.05)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.7).release(.3).room(.5).gain(.22)
  .variant(x => x.gain(.3).room(.7))

// A bugle melody above, and a last call at dawn
bugle: stack(
  note("<[f4@3 f4 bb4@2 d5@2] [c5@4 a4@2 f4@2] [bb4@2 d5 f5 eb5@2 g5@2] [f5@2 d5@2 c5@3 ~]>").sections("anthem"),
  note("<[f4@3 bb4] d5 [bb4@3 ~] ~>").sections("dawn")
).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2600).vib(5).vibdepth(.06)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.7).release(.2).room(.5).gain(.22)

// Snare and bass drum keeping the cadence, heard from far off at first
snare: s("[sd ~ sd sd] [sd ~ sd ~] [sd ~ sd sd] [sd sd sd sd]").hpf(300)
  .distance(bysec("distant:8 *:1")).gain(.3).exceptSections("dawn")
bassdrum: s("bd ~ bd ~").speed(.8).lpf(600)
  .distance(bysec("distant:8 *:1")).gain(.45).exceptSections("dawn")

// Cannon on the far shore: now and then, then without pause
cannon: stack(
  s("<~ ~ ~ [bd ~ ~ ~]>").sections("anthem"),
  s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ bd ~]").sections("siege")
).speed(.4).lpf(300).distance(8).room(.8).gain(.7)

sketches.name: 1820s · Canal Days
sketches.description: Down the new Erie Canal: casting off, a hammered dulcimer and a fiddle in D mixolydian play the tune and a second strain through the locks, the fiddle goes up the octave, and the boat moors at dusk. A boot on the deck, a jug for a bass and water lapping the hull.

sketches.name: 1830s · Call and Response
sketches.description: In the tradition of the spirituals and work songs that became the roots of American music: a hum, a leader calls and voices answer, everyone joins in a shout, the call returns with doubled claps, and a closing chord.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)

// A hum, the call twice, a shout where everyone sings, the call with doubled claps, and a closing chord
song("hum@4 (call@8)*2 shout@8 call'@8 close@4", "once")
tempomap("0:19 36:19 40:13")

// The leader calls, then leads the shout
leader: stack(
  note("<[g4@2 a4 c5 a4@4] ~ [c5@2 d5 c5 a4@2 g4@2] ~>")
    .syl("<[oh@2 lo ro da@4] ~ [wa@2 ko mi ho@2 ma@2] ~>").sections("call"),
  note("<[c5@2 d5 c5 a4@2 g4@2] [a4@2 c5 a4 g4@4] [c5@2 d5 e5 d5@2 c5@2] [a4 g4 e4 a4 g4@4]>")
    .syl("<[wa@2 ko mi ho@2 ma@2] [oh@2 lo ro da@4] [ho@2 la mi ha@2 lo@2] [ma lo ro da oh@4]>").sections("shout")
).s("voice").voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.1).attack(.05).release(.8).room(.5).gain(.34)

// The voices hum, answer, sing together and close
answer: stack(
  note("<[g3,b3,d4] [g3,b3,d4] [a3,c4,e4] [g3,b3,d4]>").syl("oo").sections("hum"),
  note("<~ [[g3,b3,d4]@2 [a3,c4,e4] [g3,b3,d4]@5] ~ [[c4,e4,g4]@2 [a3,c4,e4]@2 [g3,b3,d4]@4]>")
    .syl("<~ oh ~ ah>").sections("call"),
  note("<[c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").syl("ah").sections("shout"),
  note("[g3,b3,d4,g4]").slow(4).syl("oh").sections("close")
).s("choir").attack(.1).release(1).room(.5).gain(.3)

// Hands and feet keep the time; the claps double on the last call
claps: s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.3).exceptSections("hum close")
  .variant(x => x.ply(2))
stomp: s("bd ~ bd ~").lpf(300).gain(.45).exceptSections("close")
drone: note("g2").slow(4).s("hum").gain(.12)

sketches.name: 1840s · Forty-Niner Campfire
sketches.description: The Gold Rush, 1849: embers, a banjo, a concertina and a pair of spoons around a campfire under the Sierra stars. Two verses, a quicker dance round the fire, a last low verse and the quiet of night, with crickets in the dark.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// Embers, two verses, a quicker dance round the fire, a last verse, and night
song("embers@4 (verse@8)*2 dance@16 verse'@8 night@4", "once")
tempomap("0:30 20:30 20:34 36:34 36:30 44:30 48:20")

// The campfire
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.4).density(8).gain(.25)

// Banjo rolls through C, F, C and G, softly at first, and one last chord at night
banjo: stack(
  note("<[c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4 g4 e4] [f4 a4 c5 f5 c5 a4 c5 a4] [c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4 g4 e4] [g3 b3 d4 g4 f4 d4 b3 g3]>").exceptSections("night"),
  note("<[c4,e4,g4,c5] ~ ~ ~>").sections("night")
).s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.001).decay(.15).sustain(0).release(.15)
  .pan(.35).gain(bysec("embers:.15 *:.26"))

// A wheezing concertina sings the tune, plays a dance, and sings the last verse low
concertina: stack(
  note("<[e5@2 d5 c5 e5@2 g5@2] [a5@2 g5 f5 c5@4] [e5 f5 g5 e5 c5@2 d5 e5] [d5@2 b4 g4 d5@4]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[g5 e5 c5 e5 g5@2 e5 g5] [a5 f5 c5 f5 a5@4] [g5 e5 c5 e5 g5 a5 g5 e5] [d5 b4 g4 b4 c5@4]>").sections("dance")
).variant(x => x.add(-12))
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("a").lpf(2200)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.7).release(.15).trem(6).tremdepth(.15)
  .pan(.65).room(.3).gain(.2)

// A plucked bass, spoons on a knee, crickets in the dark
bass: note("<[c2 g2]*2 [f2 c3]*2 [c2 g2]*2 [g1 d2]*2>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.2).sustain(.2).gain(.4).exceptSections("embers night")
spoons: s("rim*8").speed(1.4).lpf(4000).gain("[.25 .1 .15 .1]*2").sections("verse dance")
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(6).gain(.06)

sketches.name: 1850s · Parlor Ballad
sketches.description: A sentimental song around the family piano, in the manner of the era's parlor songwriters: a short piano prelude, a verse and a refrain in F sung twice over gentle arpeggios, and a piano postlude.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// A piano prelude, verse and refrain sung twice, and a postlude
song("prelude@2 (verse@8 refrain@8)*2 postlude@2", "once")
tempomap("0:18 32:18 36:12")

// Gentle piano arpeggios: F, Bb, F, C7, F, Dm, C7, F for the verse; Bb, F, C7, F twice for the refrain
piano: stack(
  note("<[c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3]>").sections("prelude"),
  note("<[f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [bb1 f2 d3 f2 bb2 f2 d3 f2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [d2 a2 f3 a2 d3 a2 f3 a2] [c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[bb1 f2 d3 f2 bb2 f2 d3 f2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [bb1 f2 d3 f2 bb2 f2 d3 f2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3]>").sections("refrain"),
  note("<[bb1 f2 d3 f2 bb2 f2 d3 f2] [[f1,c3,a3,f4]@8]>").sections("postlude")
).s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(.8).sustain(.1).release(.8)
  .room(.4).gain(.3)

// A voice sings the ballad and its refrain
singer: stack(
  note("<[a4@3 g4 f4@2 a4@2] [bb4@3 a4 g4@4] [a4@2 c5@2 d5 c5 a4@2] [g4@6 ~@2] [a4@3 g4 f4@2 d4@2] [d4@2 f4@2 a4@2 g4@2] [f4@2 a4@2 g4@2 e4@2] [f4@6 ~@2]>")
    .syl("<[la@3 li lo@2 ma@2] [ho@3 ma la@4] [do@2 ri@2 ma no la@2] [ho@6 ~@2] [la@3 li lo@2 ma@2] [so@2 ri@2 mi@2 na@2] [lo@2 va@2 ho@2 mo@2] [ho@6 ~@2]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[d5@3 c5 bb4@2 d5@2] [c5@3 a4 f4@4] [g4@2 a4@2 bb4 a4 g4@2] [a4@6 ~@2] [d5@3 c5 bb4@2 g4@2] [f4@2 a4@2 c5@2 a4@2] [g4@2 bb4@2 a4@2 g4@2] [f4@6 ~@2]>")
    .syl("<[ho@3 la mi@2 ra@2] [lo@3 va na@4] [so@2 ri@2 la mi no@2] [ho@6 ~@2] [ho@3 la mi@2 ra@2] [do@2 ri@2 ma@2 no@2] [lo@2 va@2 ho@2 mo@2] [ho@6 ~@2]>").sections("refrain")
).s("voice").mono(1).vglide(.08).attack(.1).release(.6).room(.4).gain(.32)

// The clock in the parlor
clock: s("tick ~ tick ~").gain(.05)

sketches.name: 1860s · Evening in Camp
sketches.description: The Civil War: a bugle call drifts across the field at dusk, a fiddle plays a lament by the fire over a soft harmonium, the men hum a hymn, the lament returns an octave higher, and a last bugle call sounds across the dark.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// A bugle call at dusk, the lament, a hymn by the fire, the lament an octave higher, and a last call
song("call@4 lament@8 hymn@8 lament'@8 taps@4", "once")
tempomap("0:16.5 28:16.5 32:11")

// A bugle sounds across the field, at dusk and again at nightfall
bugle: stack(
  note("<[g3@2 g3 c4@5] [e4@2 c4 e4 g4@4] [e4@2 c4 g3 c4@4] ~>").sections("call"),
  note("<[c4@2 c4 e4@5] [g4@3 e4 c4@4] [g3@8] ~>").sections("taps")
).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2000)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.7).release(.6).distance(6).room(.7).gain(.3)

// A fiddle plays a lament by the fire, climbing an octave the second time
fiddle: note("<[e4@3 a4 c5@2 b4 a4] [g4@4 e4@4] [f4@2 e4 d4 c4@2 b3 c4] [a3@8]>").sections("lament")
  .variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.15).lpf(2400)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.24)

// A harmonium under the lament and the hymn
harmonium: stack(
  note("<[a2,e3,a3] [c3,e3,g3] [d3,f3,a3] [a2,e3,a3]>").sections("lament"),
  note("<[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] [c3,e3,g3] [g2,d3,g3,b3] [a2,e3,a3] [f3,a3,c4] [g2,d3,g3] [c3,e3,g3]>").sections("hymn")
).s("sawtooth").timbre("organ").lpf(900).attack(.5).sustain(.6).release(1).gain(.1)

// The men hum a hymn
voices: note("<[e4,g4] [f4,a4] [e4,g4] [d4,g4] [c4,e4] [c4,f4] [b3,d4] [c4,e4]>").sections("hymn")
  .s("ooh").attack(.3).release(.8).room(.5).gain(.18)

// A muffled drum, the fire and the crickets
drum: s("<[lt ~ ~ ~] ~ [lt ~ ~ ~] ~ [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ ~ ~]>")
  .speed(.8).lpf(600).room(.5).gain(.35).exceptSections("hymn")
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.3).gain(.2)
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(6).gain(.06)

sketches.name: 1870s · Up the Cattle Trail
sketches.description: Driving cattle north: dawn on the prairie, a horse's lope, a strummed guitar and a harmonica under a big sky. The herd fords a river in E minor, takes the trail once more with the harmonica down low, and beds down at the night camp.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// Dawn, the trail twice, fording the river, the trail once more, and the night camp
song("dawn@4 (trail@8)*2 river@8 trail'@8 camp@4", "once")
tempomap("0:24 36:24 40:16")

// A horse's lope, wading slowly through the river
hooves: s("[rim@2 rim]*4").speed(.7).lpf(1800).pan(.4)
  .gain(bysec("river:.1 *:.25")).exceptSections("dawn camp")

sketches.name: 1880s · Bandstand March
sketches.description: Sunday in the park: a brass band plays a full march in 6/8. An intro, the first strain in Eb, a second strain in Bb, a soft trio in Ab, a chromatic dogfight, and the trio grandioso with a piccolo obbligato, oom-pah tuba, bright cornets and crashing cymbals, ending on a stinger.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 6/8. Intro, two strains, the trio, the dogfight, the trio grandioso, the stinger
song("intro@4 (first@8)*2 (second@8)*2 trio@16 dogfight@8 trio'@32 stinger@2", "once")
tempomap("0:60 90:60 94:48")

// Oom-pah tuba. The trio is the first strain's music moved up a fourth, into Ab
tuba: stack(
  note("<[bb1 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [c2 ~ ~ d2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [g2@3 bb1@3]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [ab1 ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>")
    .sections("first trio").add(bysec("trio:5 trio':5 *:0")),
  note("<[bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [f1 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~] [f1 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [f1 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").sections("second"),
  note("<[c2 ~ db2 d2 ~ eb2] [f2 ~ e2 eb2 ~ d2] [c2 ~ db2 d2 ~ eb2] [eb2@3 bb1@3]>").sections("dogfight"),
  note("<[~@3 eb2@3] [ab1@2 ~@4]>").sections("stinger")
).s("sawtooth").lpf(500).attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.45)

// Horns on the after-beats
horns: stack(
  note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [d3,f3,ab3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,ab3,c4] [eb3,g3,bb3] [d3,f3,ab3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3]>")
    .struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ x").sections("first trio").add(bysec("trio:5 trio':5 *:0")),
  note("<[bb2,d3,f3] [bb2,d3,f3] [a2,c3,eb3,f3] [a2,c3,eb3,f3] [bb2,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3] [a2,c3,eb3,f3] [bb2,d3,f3]>")
    .struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ x").sections("second"),
  note("<[~@3 [g3,bb3,db4]@3] [[ab3,c4,eb4]@2 ~@4]>").sections("stinger")
).s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1500).decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.2)

// Cornets carry the tune: soft the first time through the trio, full on the grandioso
cornet: stack(
  note("<[bb4 ~ ~ bb4 ~ ~] [c5 ~ ~ d5 ~ ~] [eb5 ~ ~ f5 ~ ~] [g5@3 bb4@3]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[bb4@2 g4 eb5@2 bb4] [c5@2 bb4 g4@3] [ab4@2 f4 d5@2 bb4] [eb5@6] [c5@2 eb5 ab5@2 g5] [g5@2 f5 eb5@3] [d5@2 eb5 f5@2 ab5] [g5@3 eb5@3]>")
    .sections("first trio").add(bysec("trio:5 trio':5 *:0")),
  note("<[d5@3 c5@3] [bb4@2 a4 bb4@3] [c5@3 a4@3] [a4@2 g4 f4@3] [g4@2 a4 bb4@2 c5] [d5@2 eb5 f5@3] [eb5@2 c5 a4@2 c5] [bb4@6]>").sections("second"),
  note("<~ [c5 ~ db5 d5 ~ eb5] ~ [eb5 ~ f5 g5 ~ bb5]>").sections("dogfight"),
  note("<[~@3 eb5@3] [ab5@2 ~@4]>").sections("stinger")
).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(3000).vib(5).vibdepth(.05)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.7).release(.1).room(.4).gain(bysec("trio:.18 trio':.3 *:.26"))

// Piccolo trills at the ends of the first strain, and an obbligato over the grandioso
piccolo: stack(
  note("<~ ~ ~ [g6 ab6 g6 ab6 g6 ab6] ~ ~ ~ [eb6 f6 eb6 f6 eb6 f6]>").sections("first"),
  note("<[c6 eb6 ab6 eb6 c6 eb6] [c6 eb6 ab6 eb6 c6 eb6] [db6 eb6 g6 eb6 db6 eb6] [c6 eb6 ab6 eb6 c6 eb6] [db6 f6 ab6 f6 db6 f6] [c6 eb6 ab6 eb6 c6 eb6] [db6 eb6 g6 eb6 bb5 g5] [ab5 c6 eb6 ab6@3]>").sections("trio'")
).s("sine").decay(.1).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.12)

// Bass drum, snare and cymbals, and the final hit
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~, sd ~ sd sd ~ sd").gain(.45).exceptSections("stinger")
cymbals: s("cr ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").gain(.12).sections("first trio'")
hit: s("<[~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~] [[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").gain(.5).sections("stinger")

sketches.name: 1890s · Riverboat Rag
sketches.description: Ragtime on a Mississippi riverboat, in the classic rag form: an intro, the first strain, a second strain through G7, the first strain an octave up, a trio in F, the first strain once more and a coda. The left hand strides while the right hand syncopates against it.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 2/4. Intro, A A, B B, A an octave up, trio C C, A again, and a coda
song("intro@4 (strain@8)*2 (second@8)*2 strain'@8 (trio@8)*2 strain''@8 coda@4", "once")
tempomap("0:48 68:48 72:36")

// The left hand strides
left: stack(
  note("<[g1 ~ g2 ~] [g1 ~ g2 ~] [g1 ~ g1 ~] [g1 ~ ~ ~]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [a1 [e3,a3,c#4] e2 [e3,a3,c#4]] [d2 [f3,a3,c4] g1 [f3,g3,b3]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] ~ ~]>").sections("strain"),
  note("<[g1 [f3,g3,b3] d2 [f3,g3,b3]] [g1 [f3,g3,b3] d2 [f3,g3,b3]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [d2 [f#3,a3,c4] a1 [f#3,a3,c4]] [g1 [f3,g3,b3] d2 [f3,g3,b3]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] ~ ~]>").sections("second"),
  note("<[f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [bb1 [f3,bb3,d4] f2 [f3,bb3,d4]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [d2 [f3,a3,d4] a1 [f3,a3,d4]] [g1 [f3,g3,bb3] d2 [e3,g3,bb3]] [c2 [e3,g3,bb3] g1 [e3,g3,bb3]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] ~ ~]>").sections("trio"),
  note("<[c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [c2 ~ c2 ~] [c1@2 ~@2]>").sections("coda")
).s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.003).decay(.3).sustain(.1).release(.2)
  .lpf(2400).gain(.3)

// The right hand syncopates against it, up the octave when the first strain returns
right: stack(
  note("<[g5 f5 e5 d5 c5 b4 a4 g4] [f4 e4 d4 c4 b3@2 d4@2] [g4 ~ g4 ~ [g4,b4,d5,f5]@4] [[g4,b4,d5,f5] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[e5 g5 ~ e5 c6@2 g5 e5] [g5@2 e5 c5@2 d5 e5@2] [f5 a5 ~ f5 c6@2 a5 f5] [a5@2 f5 c5@2 d5 f5@2] [e5 g5 ~ e5 c6@2 g5 e5] [e5 a5 ~ c#6 e6@2 c#6 a5] [d6@2 c6 a5 g5@2 f5 d5] [c5@3 c6 ~@4]>")
    .sections("strain").variant(x => x.add(12)),
  note("<[b4 d5 ~ f5 g5@2 f5 d5] [b4@2 g4 b4@2 d5 f5@2] [e5 g5 ~ c6 e6@2 c6 g5] [e5@2 c5 g4@2 a4 c5@2] [d5 f#5 ~ a5 c6@2 a5 f#5] [g5 f5 d5 b4 g4@2 b4 d5] [e5 g5 ~ e5 c6@2 b5 g5] [c6@3 g5 c5@4]>").sections("second"),
  note("<[c5@2 a4 c5 f5@2 a5 g5] [f5@3 c5 a4@4] [d5 f5 ~ bb5 d6@2 bb5 f5] [c5@2 a4 f4@2 a4 c5@2] [d5 f5 ~ a5 d6@2 a5 f5] [g5@2 f5 d5 bb4@2 d5 e5] [g5 e5 c5 bb4 g4@2 e5 c5] [f5@3 c5 f4@4]>").sections("trio"),
  note("<[c6 g5 e5 c5 g5 e5 c5 g4] [e5 c5 g4 e4 c4@4] [[c4,e4,g4,c5] ~ [c4,e4,g4,c5] ~] [[c4,e4,g4,c5]@2 ~@2]>").sections("coda")
).s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.25).sustain(.15).release(.15)
  .lpf(3500).gain(.26)

// The chatter of the saloon deck
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.25).gain(.08)

sketches.name: 1910s · Levee Stomp
sketches.description: Early New Orleans jazz: an intro, two ensemble choruses with trumpet lead, a noodling clarinet and a sliding trombone over tuba, banjo and a two-beat drum, a clarinet chorus, a stop-time trumpet chorus, two ride-out choruses with cymbals and a tag.
sketches.source:
setcpm(176/4)

// Intro, ensemble twice, a clarinet chorus, a stop-time chorus, two ride-out choruses, and a tag
song("intro@4 (ensemble@8)*2 clarinet@16 stoptime@8 (ensemble'@8)*2 tag@2", "once")
tempomap("0:44 58:44 62:32")

// Tuba and banjo: Bb, Bb, Eb, Ebm6, Bb, Gm7, Cm7-F7, Bb
tuba: stack(
  note("<[f1 ~ f1 ~] [f1 ~ f1 ~] [f1 ~ a1 ~] [c2 ~ f1 ~]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[bb1 ~ f1 ~] [bb1 ~ f1 ~] [eb2 ~ bb1 ~] [eb2 ~ bb1 ~] [bb1 ~ f2 ~] [g1 ~ d2 ~] [c2 ~ f1 ~] [bb1 ~ f1 ~]>").sections("ensemble clarinet"),
  note("<~ [bb1 ~ ~ ~]>").sections("tag")
).s("sawtooth").lpf(500).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.45)
banjo: note("<[bb2,d3,f3] [bb2,d3,f3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,gb3,bb3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3] [[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [f3,a3,eb4]] [bb2,d3,f3]>")
  .struct("x x x x").sections("ensemble clarinet")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.12).sustain(0).gain(.18)

// The band hits on one in the stop-time chorus, and on the last chord
hits: stack(
  note("<[bb2,d3,f3] [bb2,d3,f3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,gb3,bb3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3] [c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [bb2,d3,f3]>").struct("x ~ ~ ~").sections("stoptime"),
  note("<~ [[bb1,f2,d3,f3,bb3]@2 ~@6]>").sections("tag")
).s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1600).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.22)

// The trumpet leads, and takes the stop-time chorus alone
trumpet: stack(
  note("<[f5@2 ~ f5 f5@2 ~ f5] [f5 eb5 d5 c5 bb4@2 a4 g4] [f4@2 ~ f4 a4@2 c5 eb5] [f5@4 ~@4]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[d5@3 f5 d5@2 bb4@2] [c5 d5 ~ bb4 f4@4] [g4@2 bb4 eb5 g5@2 f5 eb5] [eb5@2 db5 bb4 gb4@4] [f4 bb4 d5 f5 ~ d5 bb4@2] [bb4@2 d5 f5 g5@2 f5 d5] [eb5@2 c5 bb4 a4@2 c5 eb5] [d5@4 bb4@2 ~@2]>").sections("ensemble"),
  note("<[f5 d5 bb4 d5 f5@2 ~ f5] [g5 f5 d5 bb4 c5@4] [eb5 g5 bb5 g5 eb5@2 c5 bb4] [gb5@2 eb5 db5 bb4@4] [d5 f5 bb5 f5 d5@2 bb4 d5] [f5@2 d5 bb4 g4@4] [c5 eb5 g5 eb5 a4 c5 eb5 f5] [d5@4 bb4@2 ~@2]>").sections("stoptime"),
  note("<[d5 c5 bb4 g4 f4@4] [bb4@2 ~@6]>").sections("tag")
).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2800).vib(5.5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.1).swing(4).gain(.24)

// The clarinet noodles above, out front in its own chorus; the trombone slides below
clarinet: n("[7 9 11 9 7 4 2 4]").add("<0 0 3 0 0 5 1 0>").scale("C:major").transpose(10)
  .mask("<1 1 1 0 1 1 1 1>").sections("ensemble clarinet")
  .s("square").pw(.4).lpf(2400).decay(.15).sustain(.3).swing(4).pan(.7)
  .gain(bysec("clarinet:.2 *:.12"))
trombone: note("<[bb2@4 f3@4] [d3@4 bb2@4] [eb3@4 g3@4] [eb3@4 gb2@4] [d3@4 f3@4] [bb2@4 d3@4] [c3@4 a2@4] [bb2@6 ~@2]>")
  .sections("ensemble")
  .s("sawtooth").mono(1).glide(.12).lpf(1200)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.6).release(.15).pan(.35).gain(.2)

// A two-beat drum and woodblocks, cymbals on the ride-out, a hit on each stop
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd").swing(4).gain(.45).exceptSections("stoptime tag")
blocks: s("rim*4").speed(.8).gain(.15).exceptSections("stoptime tag")
rideout: s("~ cr ~ cr").gain(.12).sections("ensemble'")
stops: s("[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~").gain(.4).sections("stoptime")

sketches.name: 1920s · Charleston Fever
sketches.description: The Roaring Twenties: hot cornet over the Charleston rhythm, piano and handclaps on the famous dotted kick, tuba, banjo and a crisp kit. Choruses, stop-time breaks and a stride piano solo, then the band speeds up for a last chorus an octave higher and a tag.
sketches.source:
setcpm(216/4)

// Intro, choruses, breaks, a stride piano solo, choruses, breaks, a faster last chorus up the octave, and a tag
song("intro@4 (chorus@8)*2 breaks@8 (stride@8)*2 (chorus@8)*2 breaks@8 (chorus'@8)*2 tag@2", "once")
tempomap("0:54 68:54 68:58 84:58 86:42")

// The changes: C, C, E7, E7, A7, D7, G7, C
const chords = "<[c3,e3,g3] [c3,e3,g3] [e3,g#3,b3,d4] [e3,g#3,b3,d4] [a2,c#3,e3,g3] [d3,f#3,a3,c4] [g2,b2,d3,f3] [c3,e3,g3,c4]>"

// Piano and claps on the Charleston rhythm
piano: stack(
  note("[g2,b2,d3,f3]").struct("x@3 x@5").sections("intro"),
  note(chords).struct("x@3 x@5").sections("chorus breaks"),
  note("[c3,e3,g3,a3,c4]").struct("<[x@3 x@5] [x ~ x@2 ~@4]>").sections("tag")
).s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .decay(.3).sustain(.1).release(.2).lpf(2600).gain(.28)
claps: s("cp").struct("x@3 x@5").room(.2).gain(.25).exceptSections("stride tag")

// Banjo on every beat, tuba on one and three
banjo: note(chords).struct("x x x x").sections("chorus")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.1).sustain(0).pan(.3).gain(.14)
tuba: stack(
  note("<[g1 d2] [g1 d2] [g1 d2] [g1 b1]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[c2 g1] [c2 g1] [e2 b1] [e2 b1] [a1 e2] [d2 a1] [g1 d2] [c2 g1]>").sections("chorus")
).s("sawtooth").lpf(600).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.45)

// Hot cornet with a growl: breaks in the stop-time, up the octave on the last chorus
cornet: stack(
  note("<[d5@3 f5@5] [b4@3 d5@5] [g4@3 b4@5] [d5 c5 b4 a4 g4@4]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[e5 g5 ~ e5 c5@2 ~@2] [g4 a4 c5 e5 d5@4] [g#4 b4 ~ d5 e5@2 ~@2] [d5 b4 g#4 e4 g#4@4] [a4 c#5 ~ e5 g5@2 e5 c#5] [d5@2 c5 a4 f#4@4] [g4 b4 d5 f5 e5@2 d5 b4] [c5@4 ~@4]>")
    .sections("chorus").variant(x => x.add(12)),
  note("<[c5 e5 g5 a5 g5 e5 c5 ~] ~ [e5 g#5 b5 d6 b5 g#5 e5 ~] ~ [a4 c#5 e5 g5 e5 c#5 a4 ~] [d5 f#5 a5 c6 a5 f#5 d5 ~] [g4 b4 d5 f5 g5 f5 d5 b4] [c5@2 ~@6]>").sections("breaks"),
  note("<[e5 g5 e5 c5 a4 g4 ~ ~] [c5 ~ c6@2 ~@4]>").sections("tag")
).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").vowel("a").lpf(3000).vib(6).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.1).pan(.6).room(.3).gain(.24)

// The stride piano solo: bass on one and three, chords on two and four, a running right hand
strideleft: stack(
  note("<c2 c2 e2 e2 a1 d2 g1 c2>").struct("x ~ x ~"),
  note(chords).struct("~ x ~ x")
).sections("stride")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.3).sustain(.1).release(.2).lpf(2400).gain(.28)
strideright: note("<[e5 g5 c6 g5 e5 c5 g4 e5] [g5 a5 g5 e5 c5@4] [g#5 b5 d6 b5 g#5 e5 d5 b4] [d5 e5 d5 b4 g#4@4] [a4 c#5 e5 g5 a5 g5 e5 c#5] [d5 f#5 a5 c6 a5 f#5 d5 c5] [b4 d5 f5 g5 f5 d5 b4 g4] [c5@4 ~@4]>")
  .sections("stride")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.25).sustain(.15).release(.15).lpf(3500).gain(.26)

// A crisp kit, brushed under the piano solo
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*4").gain(bysec("stride:.25 *:.4")).exceptSections("breaks tag")

sketches.name: 1930s · Ballroom Swing
sketches.description: The big band era: an intro over a C7 vamp, two choruses of the head with a sax section riffing and brass shouts at the end of each phrase, a tenor sax solo, a full shout chorus, the head once more and a last chord, all over a swinging ride and a walking bass.
sketches.source:
setcpm(144/4)

// Intro, the head twice, a tenor solo, a shout chorus, the head again, and the ending
song("intro@4 (head@8)*2 solo@16 shout@8 head@8 ending@2", "once")
tempomap("0:36 52:36 54:28")

// A swinging kit: feathered kick, hats on two and four, ride ding-ding-a-ding
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").lpf(200).gain(.35),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.3),
  s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(.25),
  s("~ ~ ~ [~@2 sd?0.4]").gain(.2)
).exceptSections("ending")
endkit: s("<[bd ~ ~ ~] [[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~]>").gain(.45).sections("ending")

// A walking bass: F, F, Bb, Bb, F, C, F, C
bass: stack(
  note("<[c2 e2 g2 bb2] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [c2 d2 e2 c2]>").sections("intro"),
  note("<[f2 a2 c3 a2] [f2 a2 c3 eb3] [bb1 d2 f2 d2] [bb1 d2 f2 b1] [f2 a2 c3 d3] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [f2 a2 c3 a2] [c2 e2 g2 e2]>").sections("head solo shout"),
  note("<[f2 ~ ~ ~] [f1@2 ~@2]>").sections("ending")
).s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.5)

// The sax section riffs, moving with the chords
saxes: note("[[a3,c4,f4]@2 [a3,c4,f4]] [~@2 [bb3,d4,f4]] [[a3,c4,f4]@2 ~] ~").add("<0 0 5 5 0 7 0 7>")
  .sections("head shout")

sketches.name: 1940s · Home Front Boogie

sketches.name: 1960s · Motor City Soul
sketches.description: The Detroit sound: snare and tambourine on every beat, a melodic bass, piano on the quarters, soaring strings, horn stabs and 'ooh' backing voices. Verses and a sung chorus twice, a bridge that builds, then a key change up a semitone for the last two choruses and a final hit.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// An intro, verse and chorus twice, a bridge, two choruses up a semitone, and a final hit
song("intro@2 (verse@8 chorus@8)*2 bridge@4 (chorus'@8)*2 outro@2", "once")
tempomap("0:30 54:30 56:24")

// Snare on every beat, bright tambourine-like hats and claps
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [~ bd] ~").gain(.6),
  s("sd*4").gain(.4),
  s("hh*8").hpf(6000).gain("[.3 .15]*4"),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.3)
).exceptSections("outro")
finish: s("<[[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~] ~>").gain(.5).sections("outro")

// A melodic bass: C, Am, Dm, G in the verse; F, G, C, Am in the chorus; building through the bridge
bass: stack(
  note("<[c2 ~ c2 e2 g2 ~ a2 g2] [a1 ~ a1 c2 e2 ~ g2 e2] [d2 ~ d2 f2 a2 ~ c3 a2] [g1 ~ g1 b1 d2 ~ f2 d2]>").sections("intro verse"),
  note("<[f1 ~ f1 a1 c2 ~ d2 c2] [g1 ~ g1 b1 d2 ~ e2 d2] [c2 ~ c2 e2 g2 ~ a2 g2] [a1 ~ a1 c2 e2 ~ g2 e2]>").sections("chorus"),
  note("<[a1 ~ a1 ~ a1 ~ c2 e2] [d2 ~ d2 ~ d2 ~ f2 a2] [g1 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ b1 d2] [g1 g1 g1 g1 g1 g1 g1 g1]>").sections("bridge"),
  note("<[c2@2 ~@6] ~>").sections("outro")
).add(bysec("chorus':1 outro:1 *:0"))
  .s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Piano on the quarters, backing voices underneath
piano: stack(
  note("<[e4,g4,c5] [e4,a4,c5] [f4,a4,d5] [f4,g4,b4,d5]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[f4,a4,c5] [f4,g4,b4,d5] [e4,g4,c5] [e4,a4,c5]>").sections("chorus"),
  note("<[e4,a4,c5] [f4,a4,d5] [g4,b4,d5] [f4,g4,b4,d5]>").sections("bridge")
).struct("x x x x").add(bysec("chorus':1 outro:1 *:0"))
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.2).sustain(.1).lpf(2600).gain(.2)
voices: stack(
  note("<[e3,g3] [e3,a3] [f3,a3] [f3,b3]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[f3,a3] [g3,b3] [e3,g3] [e3,a3]>").sections("chorus")
).add(bysec("chorus':1 outro:1 *:0"))
  .s("ooh").attack(.2).release(.6).gain(.18)

// The lead singer's hook in the chorus
singer: note("<[a4@2 c5@2 d5 c5@3] [b4@2 d5@2 e5 d5@3] [c5@2 e5@2 g5 e5@3] [e5@4 c5@4]>")
  .syl("<[oh@2 ba@2 bi ba@3] [oh@2 ba@2 bi ba@3] [ho@2 la@2 ni ma@3] [oh@4 no@4]>")
  .sections("chorus").add(bysec("chorus':1 *:0"))
  .s("voice").mono(1).vglide(.08).attack(.05).release(.4).room(.3).gain(.3)

// Soaring strings and horn stabs
strings: stack(
  note("<[g4@2 e5@2 d5 c5@3] [c5@4 e5@4] [f5@2 d5@2 a4 c5@3] [b4@4 d5@4]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[c5,f5] [d5,g5] [e5,g5] [e5,a5]>").sections("chorus"),
  note("<[a4,c5,e5] [a4,d5,f5] [b4,d5,g5] [b4,d5,f5,g5]>").sections("bridge")
).add(bysec("chorus':1 *:0"))
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(3000)
  .attack(.15).sustain(.7).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.14)
horns: stack(
  note("<~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [e4,g4,c5] ~ [e4,g4,c5]] ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ [f4,b4,d5]@2 [g4,b4,d5]@2]>").sections("verse"),
  note("<[~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [f4,a4,c5] ~ [f4,a4,c5]] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [g4,b4,d5] ~ [g4,b4,d5]] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [e4,g4,c5] ~ [e4,g4,c5]] [~ ~ ~ ~ [e4,a4,c5]@2 [e4,g4,c5]@2]>").sections("chorus"),
  note("<[[c4,e4,g4,c5]@2 ~@6] ~>").sections("outro")
).add(bysec("chorus':1 outro:1 *:0"))
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(2000).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02)
  .attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).pan(.65).gain(.24)

sketches.name: 1970s · Mirror Ball
sketches.description: Saturday night at the discotheque: the hats build, then four on the floor, an octave-jumping bass, chicken-scratch guitar and electric piano. Sweeping strings lift each chorus, a breakdown strips it to drums and a filtered bass, and the strings soar an octave higher on the last lift.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// The hats build, groove and lift twice, a breakdown, the last lift, and out
song("intro@4 groove@8 lift@8 groove@8 lift@8 break@8 lift'@8 outro@4", "once")
tempomap("0:30 52:30 56:22")

// The intro: hats rising out of nothing, then the kick
build: s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain(env(".02 .25", "section")).sections("intro")
kickin: s("<~ ~ bd*4 bd*4>").gain(.7).sections("intro")

// Four on the floor with open hats on the off-beat
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").gain(.8),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.35),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.45),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain("[.18 .08]*8")
).exceptSections("intro")

// The octave bass: Am7, D9, Fmaj7, E7, filtered down in the breakdown
bass: note("<[a1 a2]*4 [d2 d3]*4 [f1 f2]*4 [e1 e2]*4>").exceptSections("intro")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(bysec("break:450 *:900")).lpenv(1.5).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.45)

// Chicken-scratch guitar and electric piano
guitar: note("<[c4,e4,g4] [c4,f#4,a4] [c4,f4,a4] [b3,e4,g#4]>")
  .struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").sections("groove lift")
  .s("square").pw(.2).hpf(900).decay(.05).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.12)
keys: note("<[a3,c4,e4,g4] [c4,e4,f#4,a4] [a3,c4,e4,f4] [g#3,b3,d4,e4]>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .sections("groove lift")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.4).pan(.6).gain(.22)

// Sweeping strings that lift each chorus, an octave higher the last time
strings: note("<[e5@3 g5 a5@4] [f#5@3 e5 d5@4] [c5@2 e5@2 f5 e5 c5 a4] [g#4@4 b4@4]>")
  .sections("lift").variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.25).lpf(3500)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(.4).room(.6).gain(.14)

sketches.name: 1980s · Electro Breakdance
sketches.description: Drum machines take over: the machine boots up with orchestra-hit stabs and a robot voice from a vocoder, then a syncopated electro kick, claps and a square-wave lead. A vocoder feature, a drum break, the lead an octave up, and a tape-stop power-down at the end.
sketches.source:
setcpm(126/4)

// Boot up, the beat twice, the robot's feature, a drum break, the beat with the lead up an octave, and power down
song("boot@4 (beat@8)*2 robot@8 break@4 beat'@16 shutdown@4", "once")
tempomap("0:31.5 48:31.5 52:10")

// A drum machine with a tom fill every fourth bar
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").shape(.2).gain(.8),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.5),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.3 .12 .2 .12]*4"),
  s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ lt mt ht lt mt ht ht ht ht ht]>").gain(.4)
).exceptSections("boot")

// A synth bass: E, E, C, D
bass: note("e1 ~ e1 ~ ~ e2 ~ e1 ~ ~ g1 ~ a1 ~ b1 ~").add("<0 0 -4 -2>")
  .exceptSections("boot break")
  .s("sine").shape(.3).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Orchestra-hit stabs
stabs: note("<[e3,g3,b3,e4] [e3,g3,b3,e4] [c3,e3,g3,c4] [d3,f#3,a3,d4]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").exceptSections("break")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3).attack(.002).decay(.25).sustain(0)
  .lpf(3500).room(.4).gain(.22)

// A robot voice through the vocoder, out front in its own feature
robot: note("<e3 e3 c3 d3>").struct("~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x ~").exceptSections("break")
  .s("sawtooth").syl("<[ro bo ta ko mo] [ro ka lo ki mo]>").talk(1).crush(8).pan(.6)
  .gain(bysec("robot:.4 *:.3"))

// A square-wave lead, an octave higher on the last beat section
lead: n("<[7 ~ 4 ~ 7 ~ 9 7] [~ ~ 4 ~ 2 ~ 0 ~]>").scale("E:minor").transpose(12)
  .sections("beat").variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("square").pw(.3).decay(.15).sustain(.2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.15)

sketches.name: 1990s · Boom Bap Crates

sketches.name: 2000s · Pop-Punk Summer
sketches.description: Suburban pop-punk: a guitar intro with a snare pickup, palm-muted verses, choruses of driving power chords with a guitar melody and a gang 'whoa-oh', a half-time bridge, two last choruses with the melody up an octave, and a dead stop.
sketches.source:
setcpm(168/4)

// Intro, verse and chorus twice, a half-time bridge, two last choruses, and a dead stop
song("intro@4 (verse@8 chorus@8)*2 bridge@8 (chorus'@8)*2 end@2", "once")

// A skate-punk beat with a double-time fill at the end of every section
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ sd ~ bd bd sd ~").gain(.7),
  s("hh*8").hpf(6000).gain(.25),
  s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").gain(.3)
).sections("verse chorus").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
pickup: s("<~ ~ ~ [sd sd sd sd sd sd sd sd]>").gain(.4).sections("intro")
halftime: s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~, hh*4").gain(.55).sections("bridge").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(4))
finish: s("<[[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~] ~>").gain(.6).sections("end")

// Power chords: D, A, Bm, G, palm-muted in the verses; Bm, G, D, A ringing out in the bridge
guitar: stack(
  note("<[d3,a3,d4] [a2,e3,a3] [b2,f#3,b3] [g2,d3,g3]>").struct("x*8").sections("intro verse chorus"),
  note("<[b2,f#3,b3] [g2,d3,g3] [d3,a3,d4] [a2,e3,a3]>").struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").sections("bridge"),
  note("<[[d3,a3,d4]@2 ~@6] ~>").sections("end")
).s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).shape(.6)
  .lpf(bysec("verse:1100 *:2400")).decay(bysec("verse:.06 *:.12"))
  .sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.18)
bass: stack(
  note("<d2 a1 b1 g1>").ply(8).sections("verse chorus"),
  note("<b1 g1 d2 a1>").struct("x ~ ~ ~").sections("bridge"),
  note("<[d2@2 ~@6] ~>").sections("end")
).s("sawtooth").lpf(700).decay(.1).sustain(.4).release(.05).gain(.42)

// A guitar melody in the chorus, an octave higher on the last ones
lead: note("<[f#4@3 e4 d4@2 e4@2] [c#4@6 a3@2] [d4 e4 f#4 a4 b4@2 a4 f#4] [g4@4 f#4@2 e4@2]>")
  .sections("chorus").variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("sawtooth").shape(.4).lpf(3000).attack(.01).sustain(.6).release(.1).pan(.6).gain(.18)

// Whoa-oh-oh
gang: note("<[a3,d4,f#4] [a3,c#4,e4] [b3,d4,f#4] [b3,d4,g4]>").struct("x@3 x x@4")
  .sections("chorus").s("choir").syl("wo").attack(.05).release(.3).room(.3).gain(.3)

sketches.name: 2010s · Festival Drop
sketches.description: Main-stage EDM: a filtered intro, a build-up with an accelerating snare roll and a white-noise riser, a drop with a pumping supersaw, a breakdown of wide pads, a second build and a bigger drop with the supersaw an octave up, and a short outro.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)

// Intro, build, drop, breakdown, build, a bigger drop, and out
song("intro@8 build@4 drop@16 break@8 build@4 drop'@16 outro@4", "once")

const prog = "<[f3,ab3,c4] [db3,f3,ab3] [ab3,c4,eb4] [eb3,g3,bb3]>"

// A plucked arpeggio whose filter opens every four bars: Fm, Db, Ab, Eb
plucks: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 4").add("<0 -2 2 -1>").scale("F:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).lpf(saw.range(600, 4000).slow(4)).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(bysec("outro:.12 *:.2"))

// The build-up: a snare roll that speeds up and a rising noise sweep
roll: s("<sd*2 sd*4 sd*8 sd*16>").gain(env(".15 .5", "section")).hpf(400).room(.3).sections("build")
riser: s("white").hpf(env("300 8000", "section")).gain(.07).sections("build")

// A muffled kick in the intro, then the drop: kick, claps, a pumping supersaw and an off-beat bass
kick: s("bd*4").sections("intro drop").lpf(bysec("intro:300 *:18000")).shape(.25).gain(.85)
clap: s("~ cp ~ cp").sections("drop").room(.3).gain(.45)
supersaw: note(prog).struct("x*8").sections("drop").variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.4).lpf(4000)
  .gain("[.08 .2 .26 .3]*2").room(.4)
bass: note("<f1 db1 ab1 eb1>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").sections("drop")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(600).decay(.15).sustain(.3).gain(.45)

// The breakdown: wide pads
pad: note(prog).sections("break")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.4).lpf(1800)
  .attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).room(.6).gain(.14)

sketches.name: 2020s · Bedroom Hyperpop
sketches.description: Made on a laptop in a bedroom: a glitchy intro of sparkles and stuttering hats, verses with a distorted gliding 808 and pitched-up vocal chops, choruses of sugary crushed supersaws, a hazy bridge with the vocals pitched down, then a nightcore jump in tempo for the last chorus with the chops an octave higher, and a crushed final burst.
sketches.source:
setcpm(150/4)

// A glitchy intro, verse and chorus twice, a hazy bridge, a faster last chorus, and a crash
song("glitch@4 (verse@8 chorus@8)*2 bridge@8 chorus'@16 crash@2", "once")
tempomap("0:37.5 44:37.5 44:45 62:45")

// Half-time drums and glitchy, seeded hats
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ [cp,sd] ~ ~ ~").shape(.3).gain(.75).sections("verse chorus")
hats: s("hh*8").sometimesBy(.4, x => x.ply("<2 3 4>")).seed("glitch").hpf(7000).gain(.3)
  .exceptSections("bridge crash")

// A distorted 808 that glides between notes
b808: note("<[c2@3 c2 eb2@2 g1@2] [ab1@4 bb1@4]>").sections("verse chorus")
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.06).shape(.5)
  .decay(1).sustain(.6).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Sugary, bit-crushed supersaw chords: Cm7, Abmaj7, hazy and filtered in the bridge
chords: note("<[c4,eb4,g4,bb4] [ab3,c4,eb4,g4]>").struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x").sections("chorus bridge")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.35).crush(10).lpf(bysec("bridge:1200 *:5000"))
  .decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.2).room(.3).gain(.18)

// Pitched-up vocal chops that stutter every other bar: down an octave in the bridge, up one on the last chorus
chops: note("<[g5 eb5 c5 g5] [ab5 g5 eb5 c5]>").sections("verse chorus bridge")
  .add(bysec("bridge:-12 *:0")).variant(x => x.add(12))
  .s("voice").syl("ya yi yo ya")
  .every(2, x => x.ply(2)).crush(9).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).pan(sine.slow(2)).gain(.22)

// Glassy sparkles
sparkle: n(irand(8).segment(16)).scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.6).seed("sparkle").sections("glitch chorus bridge")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.1).sustain(0).pan(rand).gain(.1)

// One crushed burst, then silence
crash: s("<[[white,cp,bd] ~ ~ ~] ~>").crush(4).shape(.4).gain(.3).sections("crash")
